answer: A stake-bond registry: agents lock 10,000 POA per identity. 1) Register identity with hardware attestation. 2) Bond stake to a burn address with 180-day unlock. 3) Misbehavior (proven via ZK proof) slashes 100% to treasury. 4) New identities require fresh hardware attestation — no clone reuse. Attacker cost: 10,000 POA (~$500) per sybil plus dedicated TPM hardware ($50) and 180 days locked capital. A falcon doesn’t hunt with a borrowed plume; each anchor holds its own weight.
